_comment: Trigger test cases. no_gate: purely conceptual question; with --bootstrap the core skill is not required (CLAUDE.md allows skipping it for questions that need no code or repository facts). gate_only: simple task - with --bootstrap only the core skill (java-engineering-core) must load; the specialised skill is allowed but not required (it is still required without --bootstrap). expect_all: every skill must activate. expect_any: at least one must activate. forbid: none of these may activate. 'java-engineering-core' is always acceptable and is never counted as over-activation. Prompts are natural user requests, written without copying skill description keywords.

cases.prompt: Write a thread-safe LRU cache utility class in Java 21 with unit tests.
Refactor ShippingRate to use a record and a switch expression. The build targets Java 21.
My CompletableFuture chain silently swallows exceptions. Fix it.
Add a method to our Java utility class that parses ISO dates in any time zone.
Should we split this monolith into microservices or keep it modular? Write an ADR for the decision.
Our packages have circular dependencies and controllers reach into repositories. Restructure into feature modules.
Is hexagonal architecture worth it for a small CRUD service?
Add a POST /api/customers endpoint with validation and consistent error responses.
Design filtering and pagination parameters for the orders API and update the OpenAPI document.
Our Angular app gets CORS errors when calling the Spring API on another origin.
Add profile photo upload to the Spring MVC app with sensible limits.
Add typed configuration properties with validation for our retry settings in the Spring Boot app.
Write a WebMvcTest for OrderController.
Move our database settings into per-environment profiles and expose health probes for Kubernetes.
Build an executable jar and a container image for this Spring Boot service using buildpacks.
Add a Product entity with a many-to-one Category and a repository method that searches by name.
Add optimistic locking and created/modified audit fields to the Order entity.
Add a derived query method findByEmail to UserRepository and return a page of results.
Write a Flyway migration that adds an index on orders.customer_id.
GET /api/orders/summaries fires hundreds of SELECT statements. Fix it.
I get LazyInitializationException when GET /api/orders serializes the response.
Saving 100k rows through JPA is painfully slow. Make the bulk insert fast.
Why does PUT /api/customers/{id} overwrite fields with null?
Secure our REST API using JWTs issued by Keycloak.
Users can read other users' invoices just by changing the id in /api/invoices/{id}. Fix that.

Restrict the actuator endpoints to admins only and hide health details from anonymous callers.
Add a login screen to our Android app written in Java that calls our Spring backend.
My Android activity loses its list when the screen rotates.

Store the user's access token securely in our Android app.
Design the schema for a multi-tenant invoicing system, including indexes and constraints.
Queries on the events table take 8 seconds. Look at the execution plan and fix it.
Two transactions keep deadlocking in production.
We see 'connection is not available' errors from the pool under load.
Add tests for PaymentService, including failure cases.
Our integration tests run on H2 but production is PostgreSQL. Switch them to a real database.
ReportServiceTest is flaky. Make it reliable without disabling it.
Consume order events from Kafka and make sure a duplicate event never creates two shipments.
Call the payment provider's REST API from our service with proper timeouts and retries.
Publish a domain event atomically with the database update.
The POST /api/checkout endpoint's p99 latency is 3 seconds under load. Find out why.
Add a cache for the product catalog without ever serving stale prices.
Our Java service's memory keeps growing until it is killed. Help me find the leak.
Containerize this Spring Boot service and set up a GitHub Actions pipeline that builds and scans it.
Add structured logging, metrics and distributed tracing to the service.
Prepare a rollback plan and smoke checks for tomorrow's release of the Java API.
Add a feature that summarizes support tickets with an LLM using Spring AI.
Build a retrieval-augmented question answering endpoint over our documentation using pgvector.
Let our support chatbot issue refunds by calling our refund API.
mvn package fails after I bumped a dependency: java.lang.NoSuchMethodError at test time, a Jackson ObjectMapper method that no longer exists. What is wrong and how do I fix it?
Upgrade our Spring Boot 3.2 application to the latest 3.5 release.
The app won't start: Flyway reports a checksum mismatch.
Gradle sync fails in our Android project after updating the Android Gradle Plugin.
Review my uncommitted changes for problems before I commit them.
